answer.rationale: Electronic submission of OSHA Form 300A information applies to an establishment that had 20-249 employees at any time during the previous calendar year and is classified in an industry listed in Appendix A. The stated 75-employee count does not establish the required industry classification, and it is not expressly tied to the previous-calendar-year period.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Provide the establishment's industry classification and confirm whether it had 20-249 employees at any time during the previous calendar year.
